name: Get Sample Report
description: Download the report VMRay generated for a sample into the playbook run's storage — costs no quota.

sample_id.description: VMRay sample ID — e.g. the `sample_ids` of Get Submission Result or Get Samples By Hash.
sample_id.title: Sample ID

submission_id.description: VMRay submission ID — e.g. the `submission_ids` of Get Submission Result. It is resolved to its sample with one GET /submission/{id}. Used when `sample_id` is empty.
submission_id.title: Submission ID

max_size_mb.description: The largest report accepted, in megabytes; a bigger one fails the action.
max_size_mb.title: Max size (MB)

files.description: The saved file as {"path": ...} in the playbook run's storage.
files.title: Files

size.description: Size of the file in bytes.
size.title: Size

sample_id.description: The sample the report belongs to.
sample_id.title: Sample ID

content_type.description: The Content-Type VMRay answered with, e.g. 'application/pdf'.
content_type.title: Content Type
